newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen up as KGHM offering begins.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen up as KGHM offering begins.

text.p: Polish shares were seen rising on Monday after Friday's strong post-fixing buying but analysts expected the bourse to maintain its slight downtrend this week during the public offering of copper giant KGHM Polska Miedz.
On Friday the Polish treasury set the minimum institutional price of the KGHM issue shares at 19.5 zlotys, the retail price at a fixed 19 zlotys.
Analysts said large Bank Handlowy should start main market trade on Monday above 40 zlotys after having sold at its IPO at 35 and could reach 45 zlotys before profit-taking falls set in.
